1 Introduction Named entity typing is the task of detecting the type (e.g., person, location, or organization) of a named entity in natural language text. Entity type information has shown to be useful in natural language tasks such as question answering (Lee et al., 2006), knowledge-base population (Carl- son et al., 2010; Mitchell et al., 2015), and co- reference resolution (Recasens et al., 2013).
